## This work (Р-220)

Source of numbers and facts: the English original `fears-sharp-little-needles-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show fears-sharp-little-needles-en <page>`; check numbers on the page image `pages.py image`; the page map found no printed numbers — find the printed/physical relation on the page images and report it). Russian text and names: the owner's working translation `C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\2_Обработка\fears-sharp-little-needles\document.html` (markers «Страница оригинала N» align it with the original; the owner ranks above our translation, but every number comes from the English page; where the owner's text and the original differ in facts, follow the original and note it). The owner's folders `2_Обработка\2020 Dissociation`, `…\1920 Bless the Beast and Children`, `…\1920 Mothers Love`, `…\2021 Number 7 Dream` hold his separate translations of single scenarios — if one is yours, prefer its wording over the collection file and note which you used. Official Russian forms of known Mythos names: glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records. Flag `translated` on records with our or the owner's translation. Run tools as `python -B …`.

- Each scenario is its own `scenario` record. Records — book-scoped `fears-sharp-little-needles-en/<kind>/<scenario-slug>-<slug>` in `kb/books/fears-sharp-little-needles-en/<kinds>/` (prefix every file name with your scenario's short slug, so units never collide).
- Scenario record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, tomes, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators of a scenario are its characters), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`; new monsters — book records), places. Cities — shared records (Р-190): Grep `kb/locations/` first (Boston, New York with Harlem, Arkham, London… exist) and never rewrite an existing one — add through proposals; a city that does not exist yet you create as a new shared record only if your scenario is set there and no other unit of this plan could need it; otherwise propose it in the report. Places outside a city — under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209); a scenario without a named city gets a «город сценария» record (Р-190) inside the book. Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/fsln-<scenario-slug>-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209). New spells — draft them in your report (`kb/spells` is shared).
- `axes.era` — the scenario's era as printed (most are ["modern"]), `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35); metric units (Р-64).
- Solo gamebook «Whose Fuel is Men and Stones» (pp. 28–33) is NOT imported (Р-217) — list it in «не взято».
- Coverage: `checks/20261111-fsln/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.

## Solo format (Р-230)
If the scenario is a gamebook with numbered paragraphs, it is one scenario record with `solo: true`, all paragraphs in the «Абзацы» table, transitions as the last line «Переходы: …» (docs/conventions.md). If it is a scenario for a Keeper and one player, it is an ordinary scenario. Say which in the report. Notes of the completeness check: `checks/20261114-completeness/verify-scenarios.md` (strange-events table, three cultists, avatar of Cthugha, Paddington places, the map on physical p. 180).
